content.text:
The cancellation rate for the 2026 season so far is **5.68%** — 62,633 cancelled out of 1,102,171 total confirmed bookings (1,039,538 firm + 62,633 cancelled).

**Basis (Bookings specialist):** 2026 season = bookings tagged `SEASON = 2026`; measured on the latest daily snapshot (25 Sep 2026); rate = cancelled ÷ (firm + cancelled) by booking volume, with never-confirmed offers/quotes (52 bookings) excluded from both sides.
